<p>블링크애드는 담소유병원 담당자분들을 대상으로 외국인 환자 유치와 A:
BlinkAd provided Damsoyu Hospital's team with marketing consulting on international patient acquisition and AI search. The session was led by Soonhyun Kwon of BlinkAd.

We examined how international patients find hospitals and compare information, and discussed the roles of Google Search, Maps, websites and AI search in hospital marketing.

Connecting patient search with consultation

Attracting international patients requires more than awareness. Patients also need clear guidance to understand treatment information and contact the hospital.

The Google marketing session explored how each channel supports a patient who discovers a hospital in search or Maps, checks its medical team and specialties on the website, and prepares for a consultation or visit. We also discussed organizing multilingual information and inquiry options from the patient's perspective.

AI search from an AEO & GEO perspective

We explained factors that can prevent a hospital's expertise and treatment information from being adequately reflected in AI answers.

Inconsistent information across channels or limited foreign-language guidance can make it harder for both patients and AI to understand a hospital. We shared ways to keep medical team and treatment information consistent and develop content answering patients' actual questions.

Practical improvements for hospital teams

We discussed prioritizing treatment processes, consultation methods and visit preparation information, then connecting those details across the website and external channels. Rather than treating advertising and content separately, we focused on the full journey from search to inquiry.

BlinkAd will continue helping hospital teams understand changes in search and apply them through international patient marketing strategy and operational support.

For content, we discussed moving beyond an AI draft to identify exaggerated claims, facts requiring verification and areas needing clinician review. Landing-page examples covered information structure, FAQs and inquiry journeys for goals such as event promotion.
